WritingPreparation.title: Prepare new questions and review quality information
WritingPreparation.notice: Automated checks verify format and language. These candidates are for local testing; their meaning has not been validated or reviewed by a person.
WritingPreparation.storageFailed: The recovery request could not be saved in this browser. Check the saved result on this page.
WritingPreparation.pending: Checking whether the request was saved. A new candidate will not be generated automatically.
WritingPreparation.failed: The prepared result is unavailable. The original is preserved and will not be regenerated automatically.
WritingPreparation.reason: What went wrong or what would you like improved?
WritingPreparation.coreRepairNotice: The guidance below and your reason will be sent together to select a different question with a different core meaning. This does more than change a date, but it does not guarantee that the original text will be revised or improved.
WritingPreparation.contentRepairNotice: The guidance below and your reason will be sent together to revise the original text once. Your feedback is provided for review and is not treated as a confirmed defect.
WritingPreparation.replace: Send reason and prepare another question

states.SUCCEEDED: Candidate ready · meaning not yet reviewed

reasons.AUTOMATED_CHECK_ONLY: Format checks do not guarantee accurate meaning. No human review has been performed.
reasons.CORE_CONTENT_FIXED: This candidate was selected from questions stored on the server. It is not freely generated new source text.
reasons.CONTENT_CHECK_FAILED: The response did not pass the question format or language checks.
reasons.PROVIDER_FAILED: An error occurred while calling the model.
reasons.EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN: It is unclear whether execution finished. Only the saved result will be checked, without another model call.

blocked.NOT_FINISHED: You can prepare another candidate once the saved result is confirmed.
blocked.NO_SAVED_CONTENT: There is no original response to revise.
blocked.REPAIR_LIMIT: This original allows one revision or replacement, which has already been used.

ParagraphWriting.preparedSelection: Only the prepared candidates are selected. Check your target and the shortage at each level before starting.
ParagraphWriting.generatedQualityNotice: This question has only passed automated format checks. Its meaning and human review status are unverified.

ParagraphWriting.description: Choose how many questions to work on, then continue with the tasks already available.
ParagraphWriting.qaNotice: This page is for local testing. Automated candidate review does not mean human approval, and learning levels are not official proficiency scores.
ParagraphWriting.range: Current range: {min}–{max} questions. This is separate from the number of sentences in each question.
ParagraphWriting.invalidTarget: Enter a whole number of questions within the current range.
ParagraphWriting.rePractice: Allow questions I have already practiced
ParagraphWriting.startPartial: Start with available questions and keep the shortage
ParagraphWriting.partialNotice: Your target stays the same. Available questions and answers are preserved, and only the unmet requirements remain.
ParagraphWriting.inventoryOnly: Question selection and refresh use saved inventory. Missing questions are not generated automatically.
ParagraphWriting.expandHint: Existing questions and answers will be kept. Enter a number larger than your current target.
ParagraphWriting.restoreBatch: Each recovery can obtain up to {count} questions. Any remaining shortage is shown separately.

supplyStops.CANCELLED: Question retrieval was cancelled. Retrieved questions and the shortage are preserved.
supplyStops.DEADLINE: This retrieval reached its time limit. Retrieved questions and the shortage are preserved.
supplyStops.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: This retrieval reached its limit. Retrieved questions and the shortage are preserved.

ParagraphWriting.feedbackDisabled: Personalized AI feedback is unavailable pending quality validation. After submitting, you can view reference answers and a checklist.
ParagraphWriting.feedbackActive: Personalized AI feedback is provided for each answer. Your answers and reference materials are preserved while feedback is generated or if it fails.
ParagraphWriting.feedbackReferenceOnly: This guidance is for learning reference, not an official score or proficiency assessment.
ParagraphWriting.optionalUnavailable: Additional wording suggestions are unavailable. Your verified learning feedback remains available.

correctionBasis.LANGUAGE_FORM: A suggestion to correct spelling, inflection, or sentence structure.
correctionBasis.TASK_FACT_CONFLICT: A suggestion to correct content that differs from facts stated in the task.
correctionBasis.TASK_CONDITION_CONFLICT: A suggestion to correct content that conflicts with the task instructions or conditions.

ParagraphWriting.hypotheticalExample: This is a hypothetical example, not a fact from your answer or a required correction.
ParagraphWriting.missingRequirementEvidence: Guidance on missing content is based on the task requirements.
ParagraphWriting.activityNote: The plan's practice activity is saved separately from its feedback status. Scores and study time are not calculated.
ParagraphWriting.deleteConfirm: Delete this plan's answers, feedback, and practice activity?
ParagraphWriting.missingRequirementPart: Your answer does not contain this required element.
ParagraphWriting.requirementPartEvidence: Evidence for this element in your answer
ParagraphWriting.retryFeedback: Retry feedback for this answer only
ParagraphWriting.noScore: Answers submitted here do not affect official scores, growth metrics, or automatic level progression.
ParagraphWriting.distributionDeviation: Available versus target counts and distribution differences by type. Increasing the target will not delete existing questions to match the ratios.
ParagraphWriting.workloadNotice: Paragraph length does not guarantee completion time or difficulty. Expected answer length and time have not been estimated.
ParagraphWriting.page: Page {page} / {pages} · Up to {size} questions per page
ParagraphWriting.multipleAnswers: Reference answers are not the only correct answers. Other expressions that meet the conditions are also possible.
ParagraphWriting.loadConfigFailed: Could not load the current workload settings. Please try again.
ParagraphWriting.requestFailed: The request failed. Valid questions and your answers are preserved. Check the saved content before trying again.
ParagraphWriting.stale: The question or plan has changed. Refresh the saved content and check again.
ParagraphWriting.unavailable: There are not enough questions for the current requirements. Check availability again.
ParagraphWriting.policyConflict: Another Writing policy record exists for this date and type. Continue your existing practice.
ParagraphWriting.languageConflict: Your current language settings differ from the saved plan. Check the languages in that plan.
ParagraphWriting.contractInvalid: The saved response's counts, policy, or reference release conditions could not be verified, so it is not displayed.
ParagraphWriting.signedOut: Sign in to use the local testing page.
